mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 100 thousand in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a monetary tightening cycle that simultaneously reduces liquidity and weakens labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:June 2022 FEDFUNDS at 0.77% and UNRATE at 3.6%
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return prediction fails in more than 55% of instances where both series rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, INDPRO declines and SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (index), it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:April 2022 HOUST at 1,820 and INDPRO at 101.44
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * INDPRO) has a Rank IC below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the negative return prediction fails in more than 55% of instances where both series decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:May 2022 UNRATE at 3.6% (above 3.5%) and PAYEMS at 151,924 thousand
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, PAYEMS declines and SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
